indirectness.reason: 9 of 9 studies raise high applicability concern for patient selection (100%): the pooled contrast is case versus healthy control, not the differential diagnosis a clinician faces

imprecision.reason: 95% modified Hartung-Knapp (mHK) interval around the primary pooled AUC (9 studies) spans 0.102 (0.782-0.883); 95% prediction interval 0.652-0.935

publication_bias.reason: Egger p = 0.0262 (one estimate per study) and 0.0249 (every estimate); with 9 independent studies the test is underpowered and not used to downgrade, so publication bias is not assessable by test and cannot be excluded

bivariate_summary_of_findings_scope: exploratory, AD and PD combined, 12 independent studies with a paired sensitivity and specificity; not disease-specific and not the basis for either disease's GRADE rating above
reading_en: AD and PD are rated separately because they are different diagnostic questions with different evidence bases (9 AD and 9 PD studies in the primary, circulating AUC pool), and a single combined verdict would obscure that PD's evidence is more heterogeneous (I2 85.8% versus AD's 68.9%). Both ratings are very low, driven by the same structural facts: every study is a case-versus-healthy-control design, no study pre-specified its positivity threshold, and heterogeneity is high to extreme. The combined bivariate summary of findings below is a secondary, exploratory illustration of what a pooled operating point would imply clinically, drawn from only 12 studies, and should not be read as a validated clinical accuracy for either disease individually.
reading_pt: AD e PD sao classificadas separadamente porque sao perguntas diagnosticas diferentes com bases de evidencia diferentes (9 estudos de AD e 9 de PD no pool primario circulante de AUC), e um veredito unico combinado esconderia que a evidencia de PD e mais heterogenea (I2 85.8% contra 68.9% de AD). As duas classificacoes sao muito baixas, guiadas pelos mesmos fatos estruturais: todo estudo e um desenho caso-versus-controle-saudavel, o limiar de positividade nao foi pre-especificado por nenhum estudo, e a heterogeneidade e alta a extrema. A tabela de resumo de achados bivariada combinada abaixo e uma ilustracao secundaria e exploratoria do que um ponto de operacao agrupado implicaria clinicamente, tirada de apenas 12 estudos, e nao deve ser lida como uma acuracia clinica validada para nenhuma das duas doencas isoladamente.
